item.title: ANNUAL REPORT AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR 2025
item.description: Following its Annual General Meeting (AGM) earlier this week, Kent Cricket has made its Annual Report and financial statements for the year ending 31 October 2025 freely available to view.

item.title: SETTING THE FIELD | KENT vs. OXFORD UCCE
item.description: Back for 2026! Before each Kent Men home match, we’re bringing you the thoughts of Men’s Head Coach Adam Hollioake in our series, ‘Setting the Field’, proudly sponsored by Cluberly, Kent Cricket's Official Live Stream Partner.

item.title: GLENTON STUURMAN: "I'M HERE TO BRING COMPETITIVENESS"
item.description: South African fast bowler Glenton Stuurman has arrived at Kent for the start of the 2026 Rothesay County Championship.

item.title: ECB's 'This is Cricket' resource hub live | Kent Cricket
item.description: Calling all coaches, volunteers and club officials! The ECB has launched 'This Is Cricket', a new practical resource hub from Raising The Game which aims to support the recreational game with guidance to help create environments where everyone can feel welcome and able to take part.

item.title: 📖 MATCH REPORT | KENT vs. OXFORD UCCE
item.description: Ahead of the start of the 2026 Rothesay County Championship this Friday, Kent Men completed their pre-season schedule with a three-day University Match against Oxford UCCE at the St Lawrence Ground, Canterbury.

item.title: JOE DENLY ONE OF THREE KENT CRICKETERS SHORTLISTED FOR NEW T20 HALL OF FAME
item.description: Kent T20 legend Joe Denly is one of six Men's Vitality Blast players to have been shortlisted as a potential first-ballot inductee into the ECB's new T20 Hall of Fame, presented by Vitality.

item.description: The 2026 Rothesay County Championship begins on Friday 3 April with Kent Men making the journey to Banks Homes Riverside in Chester-le-Street to face Durham.

item.title: NEWLY-FORMED KENT CRICKET FOUNDATION IS KENT CRICKET’S CHARITY PARTNER FOR TWO YEARS
item.description: Kent Cricket is delighted to announce that the Kent Cricket Foundation is the Club’s official Charity Partner for the 2026 and 2027 seasons.

item.title: CEO UPDATE | APRIL 2026
item.description: As we all look ahead to our first match of the 2026 season, I’d like to begin my first CEO Update by expressing my sincere thanks for the warm welcome that I’ve received since joining Kent Cricket.
